bill.title: A joint resolution proposing an amendment to the Constitution of the United States to require that the Supreme Court of the United States be composed of nine justices.
bill.latestActionText: Read twice and referred to the Committee on the Judiciary.
bill.officialSummary: This joint resolution proposes a constitutional amendment requiring the Supreme Court to consist of nine Justices.
